# Flecs C v4.2.0, from indexable-inc/flecs `indexable/v4.2`

`distr/flecs.c` and `distr/flecs.h` are Flecs C's own amalgamation (Flecs commits `distr/`, regenerated by bake),
copied unchanged from a commit of [indexable-inc/flecs](https://github.com/indexable-inc/flecs) `indexable/v4.2`. That
branch is the Flecs we want: upstream [SanderMertens/flecs](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs) tag `v4.2.0` plus the
commits of our open upstream PRs (pin it with `scripts/bump_flecs.py --pin <commit>`). Each PR also has its own branch on the fork, which the PR is opened
from. There are no local changes here: a Flecs fix is an upstream PR, and rides on the fork's branch until it merges.

`FLECS_VERSION_*` says 4.2.0.

## Open upstream PRs

- [#2357](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/pull/2357) (branch `column-allocator`) Per-component column
  allocator in `ecs_type_hooks_t`: GPU-visible components live in a shared Metal heap (the game's plan/render.md).
- [#2358](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/pull/2358) (branch `json-exact-floats`) JSON writes floats as the
  shortest form that reads back to the same value (was 10 decimals, small values became 0, `60000` became `"6e4"`),
  and reads `e+`: saves of reflected components as Flecs JSON must round-trip bits.
- [#2361](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/pull/2361) (branch `query-cache-fini-table-delete`) Query caches get
  `OnTableDelete` while the world quits: fixes a segfault on world drop when tables are deleted during `ecs_fini`.
- [#2380](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/pull/2380) (branch `script-type-scope-lookup-upstream`) and
  [#2389](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/pull/2389) (branch `script-global-var-shadowed-by-entity`) Script name
  resolution: scoped declarations, world aliases and exported variables.
- [#2385](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/pull/2385) (branch `fix/fini-nonfrag-childof-prefab`) Deleting a
  parent before its `Parent`-storage children (4.2's default for prefab children).
- Not yet opened upstream: `487210739` (constraint violations refuse the pair under `FLECS_SOFT_ASSERT`), `3a606ca14`
  (`OrderedChildren` copied to prefab instances), `ab8b8e051` (the `flecs-distr` cargo crate, fork only).

Each open PR is listed here with its link, its fork branch and why this repository needs it, and is removed
when it merges (the bump's rebase then drops its commit).

Merged, which this repository relies on:

- [#2347](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/pull/2347) (`b5dc2184`) Detect WebAssembly targets other than
  Emscripten: `__wasm__` sets `ECS_TARGET_WASM` and `ECS_TARGET_POSIX`, which `crates/flecs-c/wasm-libc` relies on.
- [#2348](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/pull/2348) (`29b36429`) Check string buffer growth for overflow
  and allocation failure.
- [#2349](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/pull/2349) (`b132b872`) Enable query plans for builds with meta
  and prefabs: `crates/flecs-c/build.rs` relies on this and does not define `FLECS_QUERY_PLANS` itself.
- [#2350](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/pull/2350) (`cb8da0c9`) A readonly option for the REST server
  (`EcsRest.readonly`), which the `rest` feature of `crates/flecs-c` sets.

## Who builds it

This is the one Flecs C in the repository and in any process that uses it:

- `crates/flecs-c` compiles it for wasm32 and for native builds of `flecs-snapshot`.
- `crates/flecs_ecs_sys` compiles it (through `src/flecs_rust.c`, which includes `flecs.c`) for `flecs_ecs` and any
  application on it. `flecs-c` with the `host` feature compiles only its glue and links `flecs_ecs_sys`'s Flecs.
- `crates/flecs_ecs_sys/src/bindings.rs` and `bindings_release.rs` are generated from this `flecs.h`.

## Bumping

`uv run scripts/bump_flecs.py --flecs <flecs checkout>`:

1. fetches upstream and fork `master` (remotes `upstream` and `fork`, added if missing) and rebases the fork's
   `master` onto upstream `master` in the checkout's local `master`; commits whose PR merged drop out. It does not
   push; it prints the `git push --force-with-lease fork master` to run after review. On a conflict (usually in
   `distr/`), regenerate `distr/` with bake for that commit, `git rebase --continue`, and rerun with `--pin master`;
2. copies `distr/flecs.c` and `distr/flecs.h` here;
3. regenerates `crates/flecs_ecs_sys/src/bindings.rs` and `bindings_release.rs` with the `bindgen` CLI, with the
   options of `crates/flecs_ecs_sys/build.rs`;
4. rewrites the pin block above: the fork commit, its upstream base and the fork commits on top;
5. prints the C API diff: declarations of `flecs.h` that were removed or changed, and the new ones.

`--pin <commit>` pins a fork commit as it is, without the rebase.

A new fix: branch from upstream `master` on the fork, open the PR to SanderMertens/flecs from that branch, cherry-pick
its commit onto the fork's `master`, list it under "Open upstream PRs" and bump with `--pin master`.

Then port `crates/flecs_ecs` and `crates/flecs-c/csrc/glue.c` for what the diff lists (upstream's C++ API in
`include/flecs/addons/cpp/` shows how each change was absorbed), and run `uv run build.py --test` and host-check.
